blocks.text: Maloomat ke istemal mein ethical issues (sahi aur ghalat ke masle) yeh hain:

items: Respecting Copyright (copyright ki izzat karna; copyright = apne kaam par banane wale ka qanooni haq): Kisi aur ka kaam us ki ijazat ke baghair copy ya istemal na karein. Misal: Research paper likhte waqt Pakistan ke students online articles se text source ka citation (hawala, yaani yeh likhna ke text kahan se liya) diye baghair copy na karein.

Avoiding Plagiarism (plagiarism yaani doosre ka kaam apne naam se pesh karne se bachna): Ideas (khayal) aur maloomat ka credit un ke asal authors (likhne walon) ko theek tareeqe se dein. Is ka matlab hai ke assignments mein jo quotes (kisi ke bilkul wohi alfaaz) ya ideas istemal karein un ka source zaroor likhein.

blocks.prompt: Aap kisi website ke paragraph ka khayal apne alfaaz mein report mein likhte hain. Kya phir bhi source likhna zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Haan. Khayal asal author ka hai, is liye alfaaz apne hon tab bhi credit dena (source likhna) zaroori hai, warna yeh plagiarism hai.

items: Copyright: ijazat ke baghair copy nahi; plagiarism se bachao: har quote aur khayal ka source likhein.
